title: Berry Blossom Celebration Meringue
desc: A crisp almond-and-rice meringue shaped for a celebration.
steps: Whip whites and sugar to stiff peaks. Reserve a little for coloured piped decorations; fold baking powder, cereal and almonds into the rest.
Spread over a reversed number outline on parchment, roughly A3-sized. Pipe decorations alongside. Bake at 120°C fan for 90 minutes; cool in the switched-off oven for 1 hour.
Whip cream with icing sugar to taste. Pipe onto the cooled base and arrange the decorations, berries and optional macarons or edible flowers.

title: Salted Almond Chocolate Cloud Tower
desc: Three chocolate-swirled layers with sweet cream and salted caramel almonds.
ingredients: Chocolate-coated caramel almonds with sea salt
Chocolate-coated caramel almonds with sea salt
steps: Whip whites and salt until foamy, gradually adding sugar to reach stiff peaks. Mix in extracts, fold in chopped almonds, then lightly swirl in melted chocolate.
Form three 20 cm discs. Bake at 110°C for 2½ hours and cool in the switched-off oven.
Whip cream with icing sugar. Spread between the layers and over the top; finish with almonds and grated chocolate. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours.

title: Chocolate Fleck Brown Sugar Stack
desc: A soft-centred brown sugar meringue sandwich with chocolate-flecked cream.
steps: Beat whites and brown sugar to stiff peaks. Divide into two 20 cm discs on parchment. Bake at 130°C for 60 minutes; leave in the switched-off oven until cold.
Melt 30% of the chocolate and drizzle over the upper disc. Chop the remaining chocolate and fold into whipped cream. Sandwich the discs with the cream and refrigerate at least 24 hours.

title: Chocolate Mousse Meringue Layer Cake
desc: Light sponge and crisp meringue layered with chocolate mousse.
steps: Whisk eggs and sugar until thick; fold in sifted flour, starch and baking powder. Bake in a lined, greased 22 cm tin at 175°C for 12–15 minutes. Cool.
Whip whites and sugar to stiff peaks. Shape a 20 cm disc; bake at 100°C for 2 hours and cool.
Whisk pasteurized yolks with icing sugar. Fold in melted, cooled chocolate, then whipped cream.
Whip remaining cream. Layer sponge, half the cream and mousse, meringue, then remaining cream and mousse. Drizzle with melted chocolate; chill overnight.

title: Hazelnut Crunch Cream Crown
desc: A single brown sugar meringue crowned with cream and chocolate crunch.
steps: Whip whites and brown sugar until stiff. Spread into a 25 cm circle on parchment. Bake at 160°C for 45 minutes and cool in the switched-off oven.
Cover with whipped cream, chopped hazelnut wafer chocolates and chocolate-coated cereal. Dust with cocoa and refrigerate until serving.

title: Buttercrunch Brownie Meringue Torte
desc: Brownie and meringue layers filled with crunchy almond-toffee cream.
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Mix in eggs, vanilla, chocolate and water; fold in dry ingredients. Bake in a lined 20–22 cm tin at 175°C for about 40 minutes. Cool and split horizontally.
Whip whites with brown sugar. Spread two-thirds in a lined matching tin and pipe the rest into small peaks. Bake at 160°C: peaks for 20 minutes, disc for 45. Cool.
Whip cream; fold in toffee, reserving some for decoration. Stack brownie, cream, meringue, cream, brownie and cream. Finish with meringue peaks and reserved toffee.

title: Four-Layer Midnight Meringue
desc: A tall cocoa-meringue stack with cooked chocolate mousse and raspberries.
steps: Whip whites and vinegar; gradually add sugar mixed with starch. Whip stiff, add vanilla, then fold in cocoa and chocolate. Form four 15 cm discs. Bake at 170°C for 55 minutes; cool in the oven.
Heat yolks, sugar and half the mousse cream, whisking until thick. Stir in melted chocolate; chill 1 hour. Fold in the remaining mousse cream, whipped; chill another hour.
Whip layering cream. Alternate discs with mousse and cream, finishing with raspberries and chocolate. Refrigerate overnight.

title: Strawberry Caramel Meringue Garland
desc: A wreath of vanilla nests with strawberry cream and caramel-chocolate sauce.
steps: Whip whites, gradually adding sugar until stiff. Mix starch, vinegar and vanilla seeds; beat in briefly. Pipe ten connected nests between 20 cm and 30 cm concentric circles. Hollow their centres. Bake at 110°C for 70 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt bars with cream over moderate heat, stirring; cool.
Whip cream and fold in strawberries. Spoon sauce into each nest, add cream, then remaining sauce, chopped bars and fruit. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Peanut Caramel Cloud Cups
desc: Brown sugar nests with peanut chocolate and a buttery caramel drizzle.
steps: Whip whites, gradually adding sugar to reach stiff peaks. Pipe individual nests and hollow their centres. Bake at 110°C for just over 1 hour; cool in the oven for at least 1 hour.
Melt butter, add brown sugar and cream, and simmer while stirring until slightly thickened. Let cool.
Fill nests with whipped cream. Scatter over chopped peanut caramel bars and drizzle with caramel.

title: Blueberry Toffee Snow Nests
desc: Small white meringue nests finished with blueberries and toffee.
steps: Beat whites and sugar to stiff peaks. Pipe 12–15 mounds and press a hollow into each. Bake at 90°C for 45 minutes. Switch off and leave inside until completely cold.
Whip cream and pipe into the nests. Add toffee pieces, blueberries and optional edible flowers.

title: Tiny Caramel Nut Nests
desc: Bite-size brown sugar nests with caramel chocolate and nuts.
steps: Beat whites with sugar until stiff. Pipe 4–5 cm nests, hollow the centres and bake at 110°C for 50 minutes. Cool.
Melt the chocolates with cream until smooth; let cool slightly.
Fill nests with whipped cream, drizzle with sauce and sprinkle with chopped nuts.

title: Cherry Coconut Cloud Bites
desc: Coconut-flecked mini meringues with cream and cherries.
ingredients: Coarse desiccated coconut, measured by volume
steps: Whip whites and sugar to stiff peaks, then fold in coconut. Pipe 4–5 cm nests on parchment and hollow the centres. Bake at 110°C for 50 minutes; cool completely.
Pipe whipped cream into the nests and finish each with a cherry.

title: Raspberry Liquorice Cloud Cups
desc: Liquorice meringues topped with berries, sweet cream and a dark candy sauce.
ingredients: Salty liquorice candy powder for dusting
steps: Whip whites, gradually adding sugar until stiff. Fold in lemon juice, vanilla and liquorice powder. Pipe nests with raised edges; dust with extra powder. Bake at 110°C for 70 minutes, then cool in the oven for at least 1 hour.
Melt liquorice balls with cream over moderate heat, stirring; cool slightly.
Whip cream with sugar. Fill nests; finish with raspberries, coffee-liquorice candies and sauce.

title: Brown Sugar Rosette Sandwiches
desc: Delicate brown sugar rosettes paired with whipped cream.
steps: Whip whites and brown sugar until firm peaks hold. Using a closed-star nozzle, pipe matching rosettes onto parchment. Bake at 120°C for about 40 minutes; cool in the switched-off oven.
Whip cream and sandwich matching rosettes together.

title: Almond Praline Meringue Torte
desc: Marzipan cake meets brown sugar meringue and hazelnut praline sauce.
steps: Beat butter, sugar and marzipan together. Add eggs individually, then flour. Bake in a lined, greased 20 cm tin at 170°C for about 30 minutes; cool.
Whip whites and sugar to stiff peaks. Form a disc slightly smaller than the cake. Bake at 130°C for 60 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt praline nougat and chocolate over a water bath; cool to room temperature.
Fold chopped chocolate into whipped cream. Layer almond cake, two-thirds of the sauce, cream and meringue; drizzle with remaining sauce. Chill several hours or overnight.

title: Peppermint Berry Caramel Stack
desc: Three peppermint-crunch layers with raspberry cream and caramel sauce.
steps: Whip whites with gradually added sugars until stiff. Fold in chopped peppermint candies. Form three 18 cm discs; bake at 110°C for 80 minutes and cool in the oven.
Melt caramels with cream; cool to room temperature.
Whip cream and fold in mashed raspberries and chopped filling candies. Stack each disc with sauce, berry cream and fresh berries; reserve a little chopped candy for the top.

title: Berry Marshmallow Meringue Party Cake
desc: A generous brown sugar meringue with berries and chocolate-marshmallow bites.
steps: Whip whites and brown sugar until stiff. Shape three-quarters into a 25 cm disc; pipe the rest into small peaks. Bake at 140°C, removing peaks after 40 minutes and leaving the disc for 60 minutes total. Cool the disc in the oven.
Cover with whipped cream, marshmallow treats, candy balls, berries and the baked meringue peaks.

title: Caramel Ribbon Meringue Cups
desc: Brown sugar cups filled with caramel-chocolate cream and dark ganache.
steps: Whip whites with gradually added brown sugar until stiff. Pipe 16–18 nests and hollow their centres. Bake at 110°C for 70 minutes; cool in the oven for at least 1 hour.
Whip cream, fold in chopped caramel chocolate and fill the nests.
Pour hot cream over finely chopped dark chocolate and stir smooth. Cool slightly; drizzle over the filled nests. Add remaining caramel chocolate and optional edible flowers.

title: Mango Sunshine Meringue Bowl
desc: A crisp meringue bowl filled with vanilla cream and tropical fruit.
steps: Whip whites on medium speed, gradually adding sugar until dissolved. Mix starch with vinegar and briefly beat in. Shape a tall-sided 20 cm bowl on parchment. Bake at 110°C for 90 minutes; cool in the switched-off oven.
Whip cream with vanilla seeds and fold in jam. Fill the shell, then top with passion fruit pulp and optional edible flowers.

title: Strawberry Fudge Meringue Bowl
desc: Brown sugar meringue filled with chocolate mousse, toffee sauce and strawberries.
steps: Whip whites, gradually adding both sugars until stiff. Briefly mix in starch, vinegar and salt. Form a shallow 23–35 cm bowl. Bake at 120°C for 110 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt candies with cream, cool, and spread three-quarters inside the shell.
Whisk pasteurized yolks and icing sugar until thick. Fold in melted, cooled chocolate, then whipped cream. Fill the shell and refrigerate.
Add whipped cream, remaining sauce and strawberries. Keep refrigerated until serving.

title: Coffeehouse Cocoa Meringue Bowl
desc: A brown sugar shell with cocoa-coffee glaze and coffee whipped cream.
steps: Whip whites, gradually adding both sugars until stiff. Briefly mix in cream of tartar. Shape a shallow 23–35 cm bowl. Bake at 120°C for 110 minutes and cool in the oven.
Whisk melted butter, icing sugar, cocoa, vanilla and hot coffee until smooth. Spread over the inside and rim of the cooled shell.
Whip cream with cold coffee. Spoon over the glaze; dust with cocoa and add chocolate drops.

title: Strawberry Nougat Meringue Trio
desc: A three-layer meringue cake with strawberries and two chocolate-candy fillings.
steps: Whip whites with sugar until stiff and nearly grain-free. Form three 20 cm discs. Bake at 150°C for 50 minutes and cool in the switched-off oven.
Melt nougat bars with cream, whisk smooth and cool to room temperature.
Whip cream and chop strawberries. Stack each disc with sauce, cream, fruit and liquorice fudge. Finish the upper layer with chopped nougat bars. Refrigerate several hours, preferably overnight.

title: Mocha Hazelnut Meringue Cups
desc: Coffee cream and hazelnut caramels fill these brown sugar nests.
ingredients: Hazelnut caramel chocolates, chopped for topping
steps: Whip whites with gradually added sugar to stiff peaks. Pipe eight nests and hollow the centres. Bake at 150°C for 25 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt nougat chocolate with cream; cool to room temperature.
Whip cream with coffee and fold in the filling chocolates. Fill nests, drizzle with sauce and add chopped and whole chocolates. Finish with optional edible flowers.

title: Raspberry Liquorice Meringue Wreath
desc: Twin brown sugar rings sandwich raspberry cream and liquorice sauce.
steps: Whip whites with gradually added sugar until stiff, adding starch and vinegar near the end. Form two matching rings with open centres. Bake at 120°C for 60 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt candy balls with cream; cool to room temperature.
Drizzle slightly over half the sauce across the lower ring. Fold mashed raspberries into whipped cream and sandwich the rings. Finish with remaining sauce, berries and optional edible flowers.

title: Alpine Chocolate Meringue Torte
desc: Nougat-chocolate brownie and meringue layered with chocolate-speckled cream.
steps: Melt both chocolates. Cream butter and sugars, beat in eggs and vanilla, then chocolate; fold in dry ingredients. Bake in a lined, greased 22 cm tin at 175°C for about 35 minutes. Cool.
Whip whites and sugar; spread in a lined matching tin. Bake at 160°C for 45 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt chocolate with cream; cool.
Fold chopped chocolate into whipped cream. Stack brownie, sauce, two-thirds of the cream, meringue, sauce and remaining cream. Finish with remaining sauce and extra chocolate.

title: Blueberry Toffee Cloud Bowls
desc: Brown sugar bowls with blueberries, soft toffee sauce and nougat chocolate.
steps: Whip whites with gradually added sugar to stiff peaks; briefly mix in vinegar. Form 8–10 nests with hollow centres. Bake at 150°C for 25 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt candies with cream and stir smooth. Cool to room temperature.
Fill nests with whipped cream. Add sauce, chopped nougat chocolate and blueberries. Keep refrigerated until serving.

title: Salted Peanut Fudge Meringue Stack
desc: Peanut-caramel cream between brown sugar layers, finished with chocolate fudge.
steps: Whip whites and brown sugar to stiff peaks. Divide into two 20–22 cm discs. Bake at 130°C for 60 minutes and cool in the oven.
Fold chopped chocolates into whipped cream and sandwich the discs.

Reserve some bar pieces. Melt the remaining topping chocolate and bars with butter; cool slightly. Whisk pasteurized yolks with icing sugar until thick, then fold in the chocolate mixture. Pour over the cake; add reserved pieces and peanuts. Refrigerate promptly for several hours.

title: Berry Marshmallow Snow Sandwiches
desc: White meringue sandwiches filled with marshmallow cream and liquorice chocolate.
steps: Whip whites with gradually added sugar until stiff; briefly add cream of tartar. Pipe sixteen spiral discs. Bake at 90°C for 45 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt fudge with cream, stirring. Small liquorice pieces may remain; let the sauce cool.
Fold chopped fudge and marshmallow treats into whipped cream. Pair discs with sauce and cream between them. Top with more sauce, berries and a dusting of icing sugar.

title: Hazelnut Swirl Meringue Gateau
desc: Hazelnut-studded meringue with chocolate swirls and sweet whipped cream.
steps: Whip whites with gradually added sugar, vinegar and salt until stiff. Fold in chopped nuts. Form two 20 cm discs and gently swirl spread through them. Bake at 120°C for 50 minutes; cool in the oven.

Whip cream with icing sugar. Spread some hazelnut chocolate on the lower disc, add two-thirds of the cream and the upper disc. Finish with remaining cream, spread, hazelnuts and decorations. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Summer Orchard Mascarpone Nests
desc: Brown sugar nests with mascarpone cream, strawberries and passion fruit.
steps: Whip whites with gradually added sugar until stiff. Pipe or spoon 15–20 nests and hollow the centres. Bake at 110°C for 60 minutes, then cool in the oven at least 1 hour.
Briefly mix mascarpone, icing sugar and vanilla sugar. Add cream and whip to firm peaks without overbeating.
Fill cooled nests with mascarpone cream. Add strawberries, passion fruit pulp and chopped chocolate.

title: Chocolate Crunch Meringue Crown
desc: A chocolate-cereal base topped with meringue, cream and caramel.
steps: Melt butter, syrup and chocolate. Fold in cereal pieces; press into a lined, greased 20 cm tin and chill.
Whip whites with gradually added sugar until stiff; add cream of tartar. Shape a shallow bowl about 2 cm inside the traced tin outline. Bake at 120°C for 90 minutes; cool in the oven.
Melt toffees with cream; cool to room temperature.
Layer crunch base, half the whipped cream, meringue and remaining cream. Finish with caramel, berries and extra cereal pieces.

title: Salted Caramel Berry Crunch Stack
desc: Crisp rice meringue layers with strawberry cream and salted caramel crunch.
ingredients: Dark chocolate with caramel pieces and sea salt, chopped
Chocolate-coated cereal with caramel crunch and sea salt
Dark chocolate with caramel pieces and sea salt, melted
steps: Whip whites and sugar until stiff and smooth. Fold in cereal and chopped chocolate. Form two 20 cm discs on parchment. Bake at 140°C for 60 minutes; cool in the oven.
Whip cream; fold in strawberries and half the coated cereal. Spread half between the discs and half on top. Finish with remaining cereal and melted chocolate.
